{{Quote|You run into trouble out here, and this is the ''only place'' in the system to land.|Lumbra|<ref name="DT 7" />}}
A [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] '''moon''' located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] was capable of supporting life. It was the site of two crash landings during the early [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], first by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[K'Kruhk]] and the [[Soaring Hawkbat Clan]], and later by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Lumbra]] and his crew.

==Description==
{{Quote|We've fallen out of hyperspace in the middle of nowhere. There's a moon that'll support life...''if'' we can make it there in one piece.|Lumbra's pilot describes the moon|<ref name="DT 8" />}}
This moon was located in a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] considered "in the middle of nowhere" with at least seven other astronomical bodies, and at least one [[Star/Legends|star]] which was [[Color/Legends|orange]].<ref name="DT 7" /> Its [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] was breathable<ref name="DT 7" /> and possessed towering [[Cloud/Legends|clouds]].<ref name="DT 8" /> From [[Realspace/Legends|space]], the moon appeared green,<ref name="DT 8" /> and on the ground it was covered in [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]] with [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] [[Tree/Legends|trees]],<ref name="DT 7" /> as well as rivers large enough to support islands.<ref name="DT 8" />

The moon was inhabited by several creatures, including an antlered ungulate,<ref name="DT 8" /> and a blue-and-red creature with a spiny back.<ref name="DT 9">[[Dark Times 9|''Dark Times'' 9]]</ref>

==History==
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="DT 7 date">The date of [[Dark Times 7|''Dark Times'' 7]] is established internally in relation to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[K'Kruhk]], the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Chase Piru]] and the [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] of the [[Soaring Hawkbat Clan]] came to the moon following the [[Massacre on Bogden 3|execution]] of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] on [[Bogden 3]]. They crash landed on their [[Theta-class T-2c shuttle/Legends|''Theta''-class shuttle]] and set up [[K'Kruhk's camp|camp]] near the wreckage.<ref name="DT 7" />

[[File:KKruhkCamp-DarkTimes7.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Jedi camp on the moon.]]
Two [[Standard month/Legends|months]] later, the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Lumbra]] and his crew also crash landed on the world after their [[Starship/Legends|starship]] was damaged, including their [[Hyperdrive/Legends|drive unit]],<ref name="DT 8" /> and they searched for parts in the Jedi's own wreck. After Lumbra discovered the younglings were Jedi, though, they captured them and intended to collect their [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] from the new [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Piru, who had been critically injured, was healed by K'Kruhk<ref name="DT 9" /> and the two then [[Skirmish on unidentified jungle moon|attacked]] the pirates, rescuing the younglings. K'Kruhk, however, did not act Jedi-like, and, out of fear of being a constant reminder to the younglings for his actions, promised to take them off the moon as soon as he could.<ref name="DT 10">[[Dark Times 10|''Dark Times'' 10]]</ref>
